segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ יֵשׁ טְעוּנוֹת הַגָּשָׁה, וְאֵין טְעוּנוֹת תְּנוּפָה. הַגָּשָׁה וּתְנוּפָה. תְּנוּפָה וְלֹא הַגָּשָׁה. לֹא תְּנוּפָה וְלֹא הַגָּשָׁה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «There are» four categories of meal offerings: Those that «require bringing near,» a rite that requires the priests to carry the offering in their hands and bring it near the southwest corner of the altar, «but do not require waving;» those that require both «bringing near and waving;» those that require «waving but not bringing near;» and those that require «neither waving nor bringing near.»

segments.he: וְאֵלּוּ טְעוּנוֹת הַגָּשָׁה וְאֵין טְעוּנוֹת תְּנוּפָה: מִנְחַת הַסּוֹלֶת, וְהַמַּחֲבַת, וּמַרְחֶשֶׁת, וְהַחַלּוֹת, וְהָרְקִיקִין, מִנְחַת כֹּהֲנִים, וּמִנְחַת כֹּהֵן מָשִׁיחַ, מִנְחַת גּוֹיִם, מִנְחַת נָשִׁים, וּמִנְחַת חוֹטֵא.
segments.en: The mishna elaborates: «And these» are the meal offerings that «require bringing near but do not require waving: The fine-flour meal offering; the» meal offering prepared in «a pan; the» meal offering prepared in «a deep pan; the» meal offering baked in an oven, which can be brought in the form of «loaves or» in the form of «wafers; the meal offering of priests; the meal offering of the anointed priest; the meal offering of gentiles; a meal offering» brought «by women; and the meal offering of a sinner.»

segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: מִנְחַת כֹּהֲנִים וּמִנְחַת כֹּהֵן מָשִׁיחַ אֵין בָּהֶן הַגָּשָׁה, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין בָּהֶן קְמִיצָה, וְכֹל שֶׁאֵין בָּהֶן קְמִיצָה אֵין בָּהֶן הַגָּשָׁה.
segments.en: «Rabbi Shimon says: The meal offering of priests and the meal offering of the anointed priest do not require bringing» of the meal offering «near» to the altar, «due to» the fact «that there is no removal of a handful in their» sacrifice, «and» there is a principle that with regard to «any» meal offering «where there is no removal of a handful in their» sacrifice, «there is» also «no bringing near.»
